jobs.title: Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description: Employer career level: Mid-level Professional. Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software. We are seeking a seasoned Senior Infrastructure Architect to lead, scale, and modernize our global Infrastructure operations. In this pivotal leadership role, you will own the end-to-end architecture, reliability, performance, and security of our multi-cloud SaaS platforms (AWS & Azure) supporting enterprise-grade customer workloads across multiple geographies. Beyond core cloud architecture and operational leadership, the ideal candidate brings deep domain expertise in Siemens enterprise products—specifically Teamcenter—enabling us to architect robust, high-performance environments tailored for complex PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) workloads. You will act as the operational and architectural anchor, guiding a distributed team of engineers across India, Malaysia, Mexico, Poland, and Egypt. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Infrastructure Leadership & Operations Management Operational Ownership: Assume full leadership responsibility for all global infrastructure operations, setting operational excellence standards, SLAs, and KPIs for availability, latency, and disaster recovery. Team Leadership & Mentoring: Lead, inspire, and grow distributed InfraOps and platform engineering teams spanning multiple time zones (India, Malaysia, Mexico, Poland, Egypt). Foster a culture of automation, reliability, and continuous improvement. Multi-Cloud Architecture (AWS & Azure): Design, deploy, and maintain scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud architectures. Drive the migration, optimization, and modernization of legacy infrastructure to modern cloud-native standards. 2. Siemens Teamcenter & Enterprise PLM Infrastructure Expertise PLM Infrastructure Mastery: Architect, deploy, and manage high-availability environments specifically optimized for Siemens Teamcenter and associated enterprise engineering software stacks. Performance & Scalability: Ensure optimal database performance, CAD data streaming/visualization efficiency (e.g., Visualization/VisMockup architectures), secure file management (FMS/FSC), and seamless multi-site deployments for global users. Integration & Lifecycle: Collaborate closely with AppOps, Solution Consultants, and FinOps teams to ensure Teamcenter environments integrate cleanly with CI/CD pipelines, identity providers, and monitoring frameworks. 3. Cross-Functional Collaboration & FinOps Alignment Consultative Partnership: Partner with customer-facing Solution Consultants and regional teams to transition technical delivery from "order-taking" to proactive cloud and platform consulting. Cost Optimization (FinOps): Work alongside FinOps to continuously audit, right-size, and optimize cloud infrastructure spending without compromising performance or uptime. Security & Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure operations adhere to stringent enterprise security baselines, compliance frameworks, and disaster recovery protocols. Key Requirements Experience: 12+ years in IT infrastructure engineering, cloud architecture, and operations leadership, with at least 5+ years in a senior architect or director-level role managing global teams. Siemens Domain Expertise: Deep hands-on or architectural experience with Siemens Teamcenter (Deployment, Enterprise Architecture, 4-tier environments, FMS, Active Workspace) is a strong core requirement and significant differentiator. Cloud Mastery: Extensive, production-level experience architecting and operating enterprise SaaS platforms on AWS and Azure. Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert strongly preferred. Global Operations Experience: Proven track record of managing and developing technical operations teams across multiple regions and cultures (APAC, EMEA, LATAM). Modern Tooling & Automation: Strong advocacy for Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and observability stacks (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana). Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. What We Offer High Impact: Direct ownership of the infrastructure backbone powering mission-critical global SaaS operations. Global Collaboration: Work with a diverse, highly talented, and distributed team across 5 countries. Autonomy & Innovation: Empowered to modernize tech stacks, introduce cutting-edge automation, and shape the future of our enterprise cloud operations. . Why us? Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Siemens Software.
